It cost us three weeks and money we barely had. The distributor walked away.

Today, that same front-of-jar honesty is why retailers trust us. They do not need a pitch deck. They flip the jar, see the split in plain sight, and stock it.

Purica: freeze-dried pure Arabica. Zero chicory.
Purista: freeze-dried pure Robusta. Zero chicory.
Bold: agglomerated pure coffee. Zero chicory.
Ultra Blend: 70% coffee, 30% chicory — stated on the front, not hidden.
Prima: premium agglomerated pure Arabica. Zero chicory. Currently not available.

We have walked away from cheaper lots and flavor enhancers because they failed the label test. Revenue lost, trust kept.

We are expanding our distributor network in Tier-1 and Tier-2 cities. If you manage retail distribution and want the product that sells itself on the label, message me.
